items.title: 🔎 Under the Radar: Kodiak Stock Surges as Eye Drug Matches Regeneron’s
items.summary: Shares of Kodiak Sciences surged more than 170% Monday—on pace for its largest one-day increase on record—after the company announced its eye drug matched Regeneron's blockbuster Eylea in a Phase 3 trial.  Palo Alto, Calif.-based Kodiak said that more than half of patients with wet age-related macular degeneration who took its experimental drug Zenkuda went six months between eye injections.  Kodiak said it plans to seek FDA approval for Zenkuda in the fourth quarter.
